WITH pm AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m, "Consigned Product" AS p, SUM("Profit") AS x
  FROM "sheet1" WHERE "Destination" LIKE 'South China%' GROUP BY 1,2
),
t AS (SELECT m, SUM(x) AS tm FROM pm GROUP BY m),
tot AS (SELECT AVG(tm) AS mt, SUM(tm*tm) AS st2 FROM t),
pd AS (SELECT p, SUM(x) AS sx, SUM(x*tm) AS sxt
       FROM pm JOIN t ON pm.m = t.m GROUP BY p),
varcalc AS (SELECT st2/12 - mt*mt AS var_total FROM tot)
SELECT pd.p AS product,
       ROUND(pd.sx, 0) AS total_profit,
       ROUND(pd.sx / (SELECT SUM(tm) FROM t) * 100, 1) AS profit_share_pct,
       ROUND((pd.sxt/12 - (pd.sx/12.0) * (SELECT mt FROM tot)) / (SELECT var_total FROM varcalc) * 100, 1) AS variance_contribution_pct
FROM pd, varcalc
ORDER BY variance_contribution_pct DESC;

         SUM("List Price Revenue") AS L,

         SUM("Discount Amount") AS D,

FROM a;

WITH rm AS (
  SELECT substr("Destination", 1, instr("Destination", '-') - 1) AS region,
         strftime('%Y-%m', "Date") AS m,
         SUM("Profit") AS p
  FROM "sheet1" GROUP BY 1, 2

  SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS n, AVG(p) AS mp, SUM(p*p) AS sp2, MIN(p) AS mnp, MAX(p) AS mxp
  FROM rm GROUP BY region
)
SELECT region, n AS months,
       ROUND(mp, 0) AS mean_monthly_profit,
       ROUND(mnp, 0) AS min_monthly,
       ROUND(mxp, 0) AS max_monthly,
       ROUND((mxp - mnp) / mp * 100, 1) AS range_pct_of_mean,
       ROUND((sp2/n - mp*mp) / (mp*mp), 5) AS cv_squared
FROM s
ORDER BY cv_squared DESC;
